# Now I have all the information I need. Let me write a script to reorganize the files.
import os

base_path = "~/documents/work/meetings/"

# Parse the files and group by file_name
file_groups = {}
date_dirs = set()

for entry in files:
    if entry.endswith("/"):
        # This is a directory
        date_dirs.add(entry)
    else:
        # This is a file like "2023-apr-05__slides.ppt"
        filename = os.path.basename(entry)
        # Split on "__"
        parts = filename.split("__", 1)
        if len(parts) == 2:
            date_part = parts[0]
            rest = parts[1]
            # Split rest into name and extension
            name_parts = rest.rsplit(".", 1)
            if len(name_parts) == 2:
                file_name = name_parts[0]
                ext = name_parts[1]
            else:
                file_name = rest
                ext = ""
            
            if file_name not in file_groups:
                file_groups[file_name] = []
            file_groups[file_name].append((date_part, ext, entry))

print("File groups:", file_groups)
print("Date directories:", date_dirs)
